value.rationale: Gives an infinite-family complete reachability classification for the natural fixed-size one-element swap dynamics of near-maximum sum-free sets. The sharp parity thresholds and non-clique exceptional components are mathematically motivated by the dense sum-free structural transition and determine irreducibility of uniform swap walks; they are not a mere cardinality recomputation.
